description: This walk takes you along a section of the South West Coast Path from Wembury to Newton Ferrers in Devon. The route runs for just over 2 miles along an undulating path with some small climbs. Starting in the village of Wembury you head east along the waymarked path to Season Point and the ferry crossing. Here you can catch the ferry over the River Yealm and continue your walk into Newton Ferrers. Along the way there are lovely coastal and river views, pretty beaches and two delightful villages to explore.
